title: BodyWrap 소재 #060 · pm amber · super hourglass · 팔·몸통 체인 결박+발목 링 · ink-black glossy lips
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 40s, Cleopatra, the queen of ancient Egypt, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, waist-length braids platinum silver hair — full body polished cherry-red amber resin fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid amber resin curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted amber sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep cherry-red amber surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID golden-orange swirls and tiny bubbles flowing through every section, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her upper arms are pressed against her sides and bound to her torso with many tight turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, wound around her ribcage and upper arms from just below her bust down to her waist, locked with a heavy iron padlock at her back, her forearms and hands free below the chain. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at hip height on its own side, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the base of the stone wall on its own side. Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her upper arms held against her sides, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains, her feet shoulder-width apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same amber, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same amber with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT amber — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure completely visible. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

poses: mid-stride runway walk toward the camera, shoulders back, one boot crossing in front of the other
